description: Manage Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 jobs under /services/data/v{version}/jobs on the registered org. Operations: query_create (POST /jobs/query; body operation query or queryAll, query, optional columnDelimiter BACKQUOTE, CARET, COMMA, PIPE, SEMICOLON or TAB, lineEnding LF or CRLF, contentType CSV), query_get (GET /jobs/query/{job_id}), query_list (GET /jobs/query; isPkChunkingEnabled, jobType, concurrencyMode, queryLocator), query_results (GET /jobs/query/{job_id}/results; locator, maxRecords; writes one CSV page to an ABSOLUTE output_csv_path under export_allowed_roots), query_abort (PATCH /jobs/query/{job_id} with state Aborted), query_delete (DELETE /jobs/query/{job_id}), ingest_list (GET /jobs/ingest; same list parameters) and ingest_delete (DELETE /jobs/ingest/{job_id}). Ingest submit, status, results and abort stay on bulk_ingest_submit and bulk_job_*. Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Run large asynchronous Salesforce exports with Bulk API 2.0 query jobs: create a query or queryAll job, poll its state, page its CSV results into workspace files by locator, abort or delete it, and list or delete ingest jobs. Use for record pulls too big for a SOQL query; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 job operation queued
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (JobInfo with id, state, object, operation and numberRecordsProcessed, or the job list with done and nextRecordsUrl; no body for delete), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, and pagination: next_records_url and next_query_locator for lists, next_locator and number_of_records for query_results. query_results returns output_csv_path and bytes_written instead of the CSV body.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued means the job was accepted, not that Salesforce finished it. Poll query_get until state is JobComplete before query_results. Offer next_locator as the locator of the next query_results call and next_query_locator as the next list queryLocator; neither is followed automatically. Report aborts and deletes from the vendor status.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Manage Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 query and ingest jobs with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, job id, documented query parameters (jobType BigObjectIngest, Classic, V2Ingest or V2Query; concurrencyMode parallel or serial; maxRecords a positive integer) or query_create body values do not match the vendor shape. sf.export_path_refused: output_csv_path is not an absolute .csv path under export_allowed_roots. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.bad_request (400, e.g. results requested before JobComplete), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404), sf.conflict (409), sf.api_error otherwise; an uncertain CSV boundary writes nothing and fails the job.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and body before retrying. Wait for JobComplete before query_results. A 403 means the registered user lacks API or object access in Salesforce; grant it there. Create the output directory and add its root to export_allowed_roots before paging results. Abort a running job before deleting it.
